indication_area: Schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder (long-acting injectable)
moa: Atypical antipsychotic (aripiprazole): partial agonist at dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT1A receptors, antagonist at 5-HT2A receptors; extended-release injectable suspension

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 202971 ... ABILIFY MAINTENA (aripiprazole) for extended-release injectable suspension, for intramuscular (IM) injection 300 mg/vial and 400 mg/vial ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (electronic signature dated 02/28/2013)

series_start_reason: Series starts at 2014Q1, the earliest calendar quarter Otsuka prints for the line: the 1Q 2015 FACT BOOK (2015-05-13) prints Jan-Mar 2014 (2.7) in a column its heading calls 'Standardizing the Company's business year'; the 2Q, 3Q and 4Q 2014 quarters are derived from the first-half, nine-month and Jan-Dec 2014 columns of the 2Q 2015, 3Q 2015 and 4Q 2014 FACT BOOKs. The FACT BOOKs dated 2013-02-13 to 2014-11-13 name Abilify Maintena only in their pipeline tables (the sales tables of 2014-02-13 to 2014-11-13 list ABILIFY, Pletaal/Pletal and Mucosta among others, without it), and the April-March FY2013 figure (4.3) first printed in the 2015-02-13 edition cannot be split into calendar quarters. The US launch followed the February 2013 FDA approval but no Otsuka document read here dates the launch quarter.
notes: Otsuka prints a 1-month line ('Abilify Maintena') and, from 2023, a separate 2-month line ('Abilify Asimtufii'). This series is the 1-month line only: the FACT BOOKs dated 2023-10-31, 2024-02-14 and 2024-04-30 print one combined line 'Abilify Maintena/Abilify Asimtufii' (51.1, 55.3 and 56.2 billion yen for 3Q 2023, 4Q 2023 and 1Q 2024), and the 2Q 2023 FACT BOOK's 'Abilify Maintena' line prints 50.5, whereas the 1-month line of the 2024-08-01 FACT BOOK prints 49.2 for that quarter and its 2-month line 1.2 (49.2 + 1.2 = 50.4, within rounding of 50.5), so the 2Q 2023 line is read as including Asimtufii; the quarters 2023Q2 to 2024Q1 are therefore taken from the first FACT BOOKs that split the products (2024-08-01, 2024-10-31) with direct_retrospective_table. The FACT BOOK dated 2024-08-01 prints the 3Q 2023 and 4Q 2023 columns of the 1-month line as 52.4 and 50.4 and of the 2-month line as 2.4 and 1.2, while the FACT BOOKs dated 2024-10-31 and 2025-02-14 print 50.4 and 52.4 (1-month) and 0.7 and 2.9 (2-month); the later values reconcile with the combined line (50.4 + 0.7 = 51.1; 52.4 + 2.9 = 55.3), so the 2024-10-31 FACT BOOK is cited for those two quarters. The total line is the sum of the Japan, North America (US, Canada), Europe and Others sub-rows printed beneath it (checked for every FACT BOOK from 2020-11-13 on whose sub-rows are machine-readable, within 0.35 billion yen). Values are in billions of yen with one decimal; the recorded value is that figure times 1,000 (millions of yen). Q1 2018 is read from the 1Q 2018 FACT BOOK's three-month column; the figures on the quarterly-data table for the remaining 2018 quarters are prior-year columns. 2014Q1 to 2017Q4 are year-to-date derivations or three-month columns from the older FACT BOOKs (see search_log). Full-year check: for every calendar year with four quarters whose full-year figure is printed in the following Q4 FACT BOOK (or, for 2023 onward in the later FACT BOOKs, the year columns), the four quarterly figures sum to the printed full year within 0.2 billion yen (rounding of one-decimal figures). Scope of the early quarters: through 2017 the line is a worldwide total whose US, Japan and Others sub-rows add to it (2015: 29.9 + 1.3 + 9.2 = 40.4 in the 2016-02-12 edition; 2016: 37.4 + 4.3 + 15.5 = 57.2 and 2017: 43.2 + 6.6 + 21.1 = 70.9 in the 2018-02-14 edition); the 2014 quarters come from the total line, which carries no sub-rows in the 2015 editions. The 2014 quarters use the unaudited columns standardised to the calendar year; the FY2013 (April-March) figure of 4.3 less the standardised Apr-Dec 2013 figure of 3.8 would give 0.5 for Jan-Mar 2014, against 2.7 printed in the standardised column, which is why the old-basis FY2013 figure is not used. The 3Q 2017 FACT BOOK re-prints the nine months of 2016 as 41.0 where the 3Q 2016 edition printed 41.1; 41.1 is used for 2016Q3 and 2016Q4 (their sum is unchanged). Full-year check for the added years: 2014 2.7 + 3.4 + 4.9 + 6.1 = 17.1; 2015 7.9 + 9.3 + 11.0 + 12.2 = 40.4; 2016 13.4 + 14.3 + 13.4 + 16.1 = 57.2; 2017 15.6 + 17.7 + 18.0 + 19.6 = 70.9, each equal to the printed full year. Row labels: in the FACT BOOK layout the brand name is printed on the line below the figures (or, in some editions, the figures and brand share a line whose characters the text layer interleaves), so each row's row_label is the printed class heading on the figure line, the only label the figures can be matched under; a brand-named label was tried on every existing row and matched none of them.
search_log: otsuka.com/en/ir/library/materials.html builds its document list in the browser from a JSON feed (https://ssl4.eir-parts.net/Custom/public/v5parts/4578/en/20210609/app/conf/common_conf.js names it as http://v4.eir-parts.net/V4Public/eir/4578/en/announcement/announcement_4.js, fetched over https); that feed lists 1,070 items; the 63 items titled 'FACT BOOK' (2011-02-14 to 2026-07-31, ir_material_for_fiscal_ym3) were all downloaded and read with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) and pdftotext

the seven FACT BOOKs dated 2011-05-12 to 2012-11-13 yield no text from pdftotext (no text layer) and those dated 2013-02 to 2019-05 print year-to-date columns (3 months, 1H, 9 months, full year) with no quarterly table; the first FACT BOOK with a 'Pharmaceutical business <Reference> Quarterly Data' table is the one dated 2019-08-08 (2Q 2019). FACT BOOKs dated 2018-08, 2018-11 and 2025-07 have unmapped-glyph text layers for the figures; 2019-05 and 2022-02 split the digits of many figures with spaces

Quarterly values come from the quarterly-data table of each FACT BOOK: the last column is the FACT BOOK's own quarter and earlier columns are the prior-year and year-to-date quarters; where a quarter's own FACT BOOK was unreadable or lacked the line, the first later FACT BOOK that prints the quarter in a readable table is cited and the row's context says why

Otsuka's quarterly earnings release (Kessan Tanshin, TDnet) and the Financial Results Presentation were not used: the Tanshin prints year-to-date product sales in prose (for example the FY2025 one at https://fs2.magicalir.net/tdnet/2026/4578/20260213559778.pdf) and the FACT BOOK carries the single-quarter table
searched all 63 FACT BOOKs (pdftotext) for the brand name; the 'Sales of Major Products' tables name the brand from the 2013 editions on for Abilify Maintena and later for the others
FACT BOOK for 2Q 2026 (dated 2026-07-31) is the latest published at the time of the search; the Q3 2026 results are not yet released

FACT BOOKs dated 2015-02-13 to 2018-05-11 re-read with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) and pdftotext -layout: they print year-to-date columns (3 months, 1H, 9 months, full year), so single quarters before 2018Q2 are derived (year_to_date_less_reported_quarters, annual_less_reported_first_nine_months) from the editions whose lines carry the inputs; 1Q figures are printed as three-month columns in their own editions or as prior-year columns of the next year's 1Q edition; every derived row quotes the line it uses and states the other input and its edition.

FACT BOOKs dated 2013-02-13, 2013-05-14, 2013-08-08, 2013-11-13, 2014-02-13, 2014-05-14, 2014-08-08 and 2014-11-13 searched with grep for 'maintena': hits are pipeline-table lines only (none in 2013-02-13 and 2013-08-08); the 2014-11-13 Pharmaceutical business table lists ABILIFY, Pletaal/Pletal and Mucosta with FY2009 to FY2012 columns and no Abilify Maintena row. The first sales row is in the 2015-02-13 edition.

FACT BOOK dated 2017-05-12 (1Q 2017): pdfplumber text interleaves the characters of the row label, so 1Q 2017 (15.6) is cited from the prior-year column of the 1Q 2018 FACT BOOK (2018-05-11); pdftotext shows the same 15.6 in the 2017-05-12 edition.

Otsuka 'Financial Results' presentations (ir_material_for_fiscal_ym2, dated 2018-05-11, 2018-08-08, 2018-11-14, 2019-02-13, 2019-05-14, 2019-08-08, 2019-11-12, 2020-02-14) downloaded and searched with pdftotext: no per-product quarterly sales table for these products (NUEDEXTA is named only in narrative about the Avanir acquisition and a legal settlement in the 2018-05-11 and 2019-02-13 decks).
